title: 17th Sitting of third session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/17/3/2025).
Approval of the minutes of four previous sittings (minutes Nos. 11/3/2025 to 14/3/2025).
Continuation of the debate on the proposed state budget for 2026, held under Rule 235 of the Parliament's Standing Orders.
Unfinished business: continuation of the debate on the Bill amending Law No. 11/2022 (Evidence Act), submitted on behalf of the government by Bilehdhoo MP Ahmed Aslam.
Report of the Economic Committee on its review of the Trademark Bill.
Report of the Judiciary Committee on its review of the Bill amending Law No. 13/2010 (Judges Act of the Maldives).
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The sitting was scheduled to continue the 2026 budget debate, finish debating the Evidence Act amendment, and take up committee reports on the Trademark Bill and the Judges Act amendment.
